 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE Z.K.SAIYED  Date : 19/04/2017  ORAL ORDER ORDER IN CRIMINAL REVISION APPLICATION:-
Rule. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives service of notice of rule on behalf of respondent State.
ORDER IN CRIMINAL MISC. APPLICATION:-
[1] RULE. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives service of notice of rule on behalf of respondent State.

[2] In the present application, the applicant herein original accused has prayed to release him on bail by suspending the HC-NIC Page 1 of 3 Created On Thu Apr 20 Mansukhbhai Jasmatbhai Vasiya Owner Of ... vs State Of Gujarat & on 19 April, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85427809/

[3] Heard learned advocate appearing for the applicant and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent State.
[4] Learned advocate for the applicant contended that the present application is in jail since 27.03.2017 i.e. from passing of the order.
He contended that considering the short sentence awarded by the learned trial Court, present applicant may be released on bail on any terms and conditions.

[5] Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and sentence imposed by the sentence imposed by judgment and order dated 22.01.2015 passed in PFA Case No.40 of 2010 by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, (Municipal) Court,
Surat, which is confirmed by learned 13th Additional Sessions Judge, Surat vide order dated 27.03.2017 passed in Criminal Appeal No.30 of 2015, the present application requires consideration and the same is allowed.
